verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows a QuickBooks Online V3 REST API with SDKs (Node.js, PHP) and an MCP server, but there is no documented API versioning scheme or deprecation policy—no changelog, version-support timeline, or sunset policy is cited anywhere. Probes for llms.txt and openapi spec both 404, and no docs address version lifecycle or deprecation commitments. missing for 10: documented API version numbering/lifecycle, explicit deprecation/sunset policy, changelog or migration guide, independent confirmation of versioning practices.
